title: Occult-minded Nazis brought in through Paperclip and Overcast run the US space program

tellings.quote: Yeah, exactly. Running our space programs and then and uh and Overcast as well, right?

plain: After the war, Nazis with an interest in the occult are said to have been brought to the United States through Operation Paperclip and Operation Overcast, the American programmes that took in German scientists, and to have ended up running the US space programme. The researcher Chris Ramsay says this to Michels as a summary, without naming a source. If true, it would mean men with those beliefs shaped America's push into space.
